Meta.title: Live Note Taker — Catatan kelas real-time
Meta.description: Catatan kelas real-time untuk mahasiswa Asia Tenggara: VALSEA RTT dengan banyak locale pengenalan (ASEAN dulu), Next.js + Supabase, terang/gelap, banyak bahasa UI.

Profile.title: Your profile
Profile.metaDescription: Account details for Live Note Taker.
Profile.subtitle: Signed in with Google.
Profile.name: Display name
Profile.libraryMetaDescription: Open and edit transcripts you saved from Live Note Taker.
Profile.libraryLead: Every note belongs to a folder (or “No folder”). Open a card to read and edit like a simple doc.
Profile.notesParentHint: Parent: Folders — organize captures first, then browse all notes here.
Profile.libraryEmptyBody: Capture a lecture on Live notes, then use Save note — your transcript will show up here.
Profile.editorHint: Plain text for now — fast and reliable. Use Save when you are done editing.
Profile.editorDeleteConfirm: Delete this note permanently? This cannot be undone.
Profile.editorSessionExpired: Your session ended — sign in again.
Profile.editorValseaHint: Run on the text below (uses your VALSEA account credits). Transcribe appends audio text to the note.
Profile.editorValseaNotConfigured: Add VALSEA_API_KEY on the server (e.g. Vercel env).
Profile.editorValseaTranscribeDone: Transcribed text was added to your note.
Profile.editorValseaTranscribeAria: Transcribe an audio file with VALSEA
Profile.editorValseaGuideIntro: Each request runs on the server with your VALSEA account and uses credits. Most tools replace the note text in the editor with the result. Sentiment only shows a short summary above the editor. Only one tool runs at a time (the active button shows a spinner).
Profile.editorValseaGuideBefore3: Pick “Audio language” before Transcribe, then choose a file. Supported types include WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, and WebM.
Profile.editorValseaGuideBefore4: Buttons that need note text stay disabled until the note is not empty. Transcribe is always available and appends text to the end of the note.
Profile.editorValseaGuideBefore5: If you see a configuration error, VALSEA_API_KEY must be set on the server (for example in Vercel environment variables).
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_clarify: Rewrites the note for clarity and cleaner wording; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_translate: Translates the entire note to the language selected in “Translate to”; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_annotate: Adds annotations and optional corrections/tags; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_convert: Best after Annotate: turns annotated/tag-style text into clean readable prose; updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_format: Restructures the transcript into the template chosen in “Format as” (minutes, summary, subtitles, etc.); updates the editor text.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_sentiment: Analyzes tone of the current text; shows sentiment, confidence, and a short rationale in a message — it does not change the note body.
Profile.editorValseaGuideDesc_transcribe: Opens a file picker, sends the audio to VALSEA, and appends the returned transcript to the note (after any existing text).
Profile.foldersLead: Folders are the parent of your notes. Open a folder to see only the notes inside it, or jump to all notes.
Profile.foldersNoFoldersYet: Create a folder above, or save notes without a folder — they will appear under “No folder”.
Profile.folderEmptyBody: Save a note from Live capture and assign this folder, or move a note here from the editor.
Profile.folderDeleteConfirm: Delete this folder? Your notes stay saved and move to “No folder”.

Footer.tagline: Catatan kuliah bergaya kampus — ASR realtime VALSEA, siap hackathon tanpa stres.
Footer.legal: © {year} Live Note Taker — demo mahasiswa, bukan nasihat akademik resmi.

Home.heroSub: Sekali aktifkan mik: VALSEA mengalirkan suara ke teks real-time. Pantau partial untuk memastikan terdengar; final menumpuk jadi catatan setelah kelas — fokus ke materi, bukan mengetik.
Home.stat3Label: Locale ASR di app — ASEAN dulu (VALSEA)
Home.progressTitle: Dengar kuliah — teks terisi untuk Anda
Home.progressLesson: VALSEA ASR realtime · WebSocket & proxy aman
Home.progressMeta: Partial mengikuti ucapan; hanya final yang masuk riwayat — mudah dipulang setelah kelas.
Home.livePreviewFinal: Poin kunci: aturan rantai — dipakai di latihan 3; bagian ini sering muncul di ujian tengah.
Home.livePreviewPartial: … masih mengenali: "Untuk soal tiga kita hubungkan dengan format ujian tengah, perhatikan substitusi…"
Home.catalogTitle: Bagaimana Live Note Taker mendukung kuliah
Home.catalogSub: Setiap kartu bagian pipeline — dari mik ke transkrip dan ruang berkembang (penyimpanan, ringkasan…).
Home.cat1Desc: Partial langsung muncul, final menyusun riwayat — tetap terbaca tanpa slide padat.
Home.cat2Desc: Setelah MVP cukup simpan catatan & pengguna — tanpa rewrite backend mendadak.
Home.cat3Desc: Ikuti panduan VALSEA; kunci tetap di server untuk demo & deploy lebih aman.
Home.cat4Desc: Jalankan proxy, buka live, latih skrip 60 dtk — tunjukkan Anda kendalikan risiko.
Home.whySub: UI lembut agar baca lama tetap nyaman — dengan pipeline VALSEA realtime di baliknya.
Home.why1Body: Bahasa ramah, jargon minim; mentor paham dalam satu walkthrough.
Home.why2Body: Satu tombol rekam — tidak memanjang timeline saat juri buru-buru.
Home.why3Body: Belajar malam? Mode gelap. Ruang terang? Pastel tetap nyaman di mata.
Home.why4Body: VI, EN, ID, TH, MS selaras — tim internasional langsung pilih kontrol yang tepat.
Home.story1Quote: UI terasa imut tapi pipeline mik-ke-teks nyata. Pitch kami bikin aula hening fokus.
Home.story2Quote: Dosen tanya keamanan API — saya tunjukkan dark mode & middleware, lanjut. Kurik nitpick.
Home.story3Quote: Saya belajar malam jadi mode gelap penyelamat. Catatan pagi tetap nyaman di mata.
Home.closingSub: Buka rekam live, ucap beberapa baris seperti di kelas — lihat transkrip langsung muncul.
Home.closingNote1: Tanpa kartu kredit — cukup mik dan Wi-Fi stabil.
Home.closingNote2: Dev: jalankan npm run dev:rtt saat uji RTT.

LivePage.title: Catatan live
LivePage.subtitle: Pilih bahasa yang akan Anda gunakan, ketuk Mulai rekam, lalu bicara seperti biasa — teks muncul di bawah secara langsung. Masuk jika ingin menyimpan catatan ke akun Anda.

Rtt.cardIntro: Aplikasi memakai mikrofon Anda untuk mengubah suara menjadi teks secara langsung. Memilih bahasa yang tepat membantu akurasi. Bahasa tidak bisa diubah saat sedang merekam.
Rtt.transcriptHint: Baris terakhir bisa masih berubah saat Anda berbicara; kalimat yang sudah mantap dipindahkan ke catatan berjalan di atas.
Rtt.asrLanguageHint: Samakan dengan bahasa yang akan Anda pakai di kelas atau rapat. Daftar ini mengutamakan Asia Tenggara dan sekitarnya. Ini terpisah dari bahasa antarmuka di header.
Rtt.micInputHint: If you plug/unplug USB-C devices, we will refresh inputs and reconnect automatically.
Rtt.emptyHint: Belum ada isi. Ketuk Mulai rekam dan bicara — transkrip akan muncul di sini.
Rtt.statusRecording: Mendengarkan — terus bicara, catatan diperbarui langsung.
Rtt.statusDeviceChanged: Audio device changed. Reconnecting with the latest microphone…
Rtt.errNoGetUserMedia: Peramban ini tidak bisa memakai mikrofon.
Rtt.errMicOpen: Tidak bisa mengakses mikrofon. Periksa izin di pengaturan peramban.
Rtt.errWs: Tidak dapat menghubungi layanan transkripsi. Periksa internet dan coba lagi.
Rtt.copyFailed: Could not copy (check browser clipboard permission).
Rtt.downloadTxtAria: Download transcript as a text file
Rtt.clarifyFailed: Tidak dapat memperjelas transkrip. Coba lagi.
Rtt.clarifyNotConfigured: Perlu VALSEA_API_KEY di server (mis. env Vercel).
Rtt.saveNoteAria: Choose title and folder, then save this transcript to your account
Rtt.saveDialogSubtitle: Give it a title and optional folder — like naming a file so you can find it later.
Rtt.saveDialogAuthRequired: Sign in again to manage folders.
Rtt.saveSessionExpired: Your session ended — sign in again to save.
Rtt.loginToSaveAria: Sign in to save this transcript to your account
